description: Commerce Assurance: submit agreement text, renewal fields or both, with the current date. The signed report states the renewal type, the current term rolled forward through automatic renewals, the notice period and the notice deadline computed from the dates, price-change terms and the termination window, with ambiguous or missing renewal language flagged. Verdict notice_window_open, notice_deadline_passed, no_automatic_renewal or renewal_terms_unclear. Other document deadlines are wever_deadline-check. POST /api/renewal-notice-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no counterparty contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/commerce-assurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

inputSchema.description: Send current_date with the agreement, the fields or both.

fields.description: Renewal fields. A field takes precedence over the text.

format.description: html reduces markup to text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
